subject: SIG: log provenance, retention and customer access (next steps)
messages:
From: Alice Romero <alice.romero@finbank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: security@finbank.com
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: SIG follow-up — event logging, retention, and customer access

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for sending over the first pass of the SIG earlier. Our InfoSec team had a few follow-ups specifically around event logging:

- What event categories do you retain (auth, admin ops, inference requests, billing events)?
- How long are each of those retained? We need retention windows to map to our data governance.
- Can customers request raw log exports scoped to their tenant? If so, what format and SLA?
- Do logs contain any customer PII or raw prompts? If so, how do you redact/mask?

Could you provide a concise summary and any sample export format we can review?

Appreciate it — Alice
Security Lead, FinBank

Attachment: requested_SIG_sections.pdf (referenced in body)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Romero <alice.romero@finbank.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-01T14:03:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — event logging, retention, and customer access

Alice — thanks for the clear list. High-level answers below; I'll attach the SIG response workbook and a retention diagram for clarity. Where appropriate I call out options rather than a single configuration so you can map to your policy.

- Event categories retained: auth (login/API key usage), admin ops (deployment, config changes), inference telemetry (per-request metadata: model id, tokens, latency, routing decision), billing/usage events. We do not persist raw audio/video.
- Retention windows (default): auth & admin ops = 13 months; inference telemetry = 90 days by default, with optional extended retention to 13 months for Dedicated/Private customers on contract; billing events = 36 months for invoicing audit.
- Customer exports: yes — we can produce tenant-scoped exports of structured telemetry (JSON/CSV) and a compressed bundle of request metadata. SLA: standard turnaround 5 business days for scheduled exports, 24–48 hours for high-priority compliance requests (subject to plan). Exports are delivered via secure Drive link or SFTP.
- PII and prompt handling: request metadata does not include raw prompts by default. If a customer has required access to prompts (rare, governed by contract), we provide a scoped export with prompt redaction options (masking, hashing) and a reviewer checklist. Otherwise, prompts are not included in standard exports.

I'll run this by Rishi and Laura to confirm the export process and timelines for on-prem/Dedicated customers and to attach a sample export (anonymized).

Best,
Marissa
Director, Security & Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: sig-questionnaire-responses-v1.xlsx, log-retention-diagram.png

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>

Marissa/Team — quick answers inline: 

1) Retention table: confirmed. Default inference telemetry = 90 days, auth/admin = 13 months, billing = 36 months. For Dedicated/Private we can configure up to 13 months for telemetry on contract.

2) Sample export: Laura will attach an anonymized JSON and CSV (no prompts, request_id, model, timestamp, latency_ms, routing_decision, token_count, error_code). Size limit: we'll produce a 50MB sample; full exports are chunked.

3) SLA language: Ops can commit to 5 business days for scheduled exports. Expedited (compliance/legal) can be 48 hours if the export is scoped and pre-authorized — requires sign-off from Security (Marissa) and Ops (Sean). We'll include that in the SIG response.

4) Redaction/process: default = no prompts. If contract requires prompts, we will run a redaction workflow (hashing and manual review for flagged items). Export bundles with prompts require a Data Access Request (DAR) form and PR approval. Laura, please attach the reviewer checklist and sample export.

Sean — on the ops load: one-off exports are IO-heavy but bounded. We must schedule exports during low-traffic windows for large tenants (>100K tokens/day). For typical compliance exports (<=7 days of window) we can run without impact during business hours. For heavy exports we'll coordinate a maintenance window.

Rishi
VP, Product Ops

Alice — thanks for the patience. Attached are the SIG workbook pages we updated and a sample anonymized export. Summary (concise):

- Retention (defaults): auth/admin = 13 months; inference telemetry = 90 days (upgradeable to 13 months under Dedicated/Private contracts); billing = 36 months.
- Export capability: tenant-scoped JSON/CSV export available. Standard: 5 business days; expedited: 24–48 hrs subject to signed DAR and capacity confirmation. Delivery via secure Drive link or SFTP.
- Prompts: not included in standard exports. If prompts are contractually required, we will: 1) require a DAR and PR approval, 2) run automated redaction/hashing and 3) include a manual reviewer checklist before release.
- Operational note: large exports (>50GB) will require a scheduled maintenance window; typical compliance exports (multi-day, small window) do not.
